notes.title: New Minigame: Platformer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/2c50e5bf9de5d596b34fcbd285e1d62d6353595e.png[/img]
[h1]Platformer[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Minigame: Platformer has been added to Minigame Blast!
[*] Jump across platforms to make it to the end of the level
[*] Avoid spikes and pits to survive; you only get 1 life!
[/list]

notes.title: New Minigame: Emote Like Me!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/a5e2f15294b0aed812b77d896e4c9afbf707a7ce.png[/img]

[h1]Emote Like Me![/h1]
[list]
[*] New Minigame: Emote Like Me has been added to Minigame Blast!
[*] Carefully watch the emotes that appear on the screen
[*] After a few seconds, remember the emotes and repeat them in order
[*] Every round the list of emotes grows larger
[*] Survive all the rounds to win!
[/list]

tags.feature: New Minigame: Emote Like Me has been added to Minigame Blast!

notes.title: New Minigame: Tanks!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/b8971718278a8d7edfa1b5cf0582e8591f5b4263.png[/img]


[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Character: Fuschia Runner has been added to Minigame Blast!
[*] The colour of Midnight Mage has been lightened to make it easier to see on darker backgrounds
[*] You can now press 'B' to back out of the Minigame screens in Freeplay mode
[*] Fixed a bug where enabling/disabling X-Input would very rarely cause the game to stop recognizing controllers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/da4fa10bfd3530c9d5437988af3c0a99b99a8c59.png[/img]

[h1]Count'Em[/h1]
[list]
[*] The number of unique icons that float by is now at least 4, and up to the number of players. This is to accommodate for more than 8 unique avatars. This also makes the game a little harder
[*] Icons stop appearing a half second sooner for a longer grace period at the game's end
[/list]

[h1]Hotdog, No Hotdog[/h1]
[list]
[*] The game now lasts 1 minute, up from 45 seconds
[*] Difficulty has been adjusted for the new game length
[*] The game now has an end grace period. This is so players don't miss the last picture
[/list]

[h1]Tanks[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Minigame: Tanks! has been added to Minigame Blast!
[*] Take control of a tank to defeat the Tank Boss by firing your cannon
[*] Avoid taking damage by learning the strategy and shot types of the boss
[*] Maneuver around crates letting them absorb shots
[*] In Versus mode, square off against your friends in a free for all
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/f0fd83d0559d3694c5c9e3743ae59bc730ef69f7.png[/img]

notes.title: Launch Week Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/b11b891de022516df062c091cc581808c336da4f.png[/img]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cover Images are now compressed. This reduces the game's size by a lot
[*] Music is now more compressed. This reduces the game's size even more
[*] We now use smaller modified (painterlyish) images for the Freeplay screen and the previous large images everywhere else. This provides the best look and lower memory usage
[/list]

[h3]Dungeon Crawl[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced player health from 50 to 40. This is a balance change to make the slightly game harder. Players would frequently finish the game with an abundance of health left (when winning)
[/list]

[h3]Minigolf[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to zoom the camera in/out using the Right/Left shoulder buttons (scroll wheel with keyboard/mouse)
[*] The camera rotate sensitivity has been reduced by ~60%. It was too difficult to reach an exact angle, causing frustration. This speed is more precise and still allows for quick view adjustments
[*] Removed the high back wall on the Windy level and replaced with a normal wall. It was not needed to stop the ball and often just blocked the player's view
[*] Lowered the unusually high walls on the U-Turn level
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update 2
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Difficulty setting now saves between play sessions
[*] When you win in Versus mode you can now attack and run in place to show off
[*] Fixed a bug where the winning avatar in Versus mode would have UI buttons attached to it
[*] Survivor mode chooses the correct minigames with 8 players in Versus Mode
[*] Fixed a bug where when playing with more than 4 players, split screen games could still be offered to play. This resulted in a crash and/or weirdness
[*] Using a new system for input (Rewired) to replace older systems. Steam Input and basic Unity input are no longer used
[*] Fixed a bug where Xbox One controllers would have up/down and start/select swapped
[*] Controllers can now be unplugged and plugged back in to resume play without issues
[*] Controllers are now detected by pressing joysticks as well as by pressing buttons
[*] The cursor should no longer appear on the screen during minigames
[*] Controllers plugged in after the game has started now function correctly
[*] You can now change the 'Use X-Input' setting to allow support for more than 4 X-Input controllers (like the Xbox One controller)
[*] Fixed mouse sensitivity issues with first person games
[*] Games should now pause when the Steam overlay is opened
[/list]

[b]Car Launch[/b]
[list]
[*] The Store and Results window no longer pop up once the game has ended
[*] The Store and Results window now close when the game ends
[/list]

[b]Count'Em[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the score was showing as 'good' in cooperative, when it was in fact 'bad'
[*] Fixed a bug where if multiple players were the same avatar, none of them could actually count
[/list]

[b]Deathmatch[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now press 'X' to manually reload your weapon
[*] Fixed a bug when a robot got very close to you, it would tilt unnaturally
[*] Players who take the lead now have their name displayed in cooperative mode
[*] Fixed a bug that disabled use of the right joystick
[*] Laser now 'spark' when they hit objects, making it easier to see if/when you hit something
[*] Robots now disintegrate when defeated
[*] The Invalidator is now less inaccurate
[*] The 'arena' now has coloured distinct markers corresponding to what quadrant you are in. This is so players no longer get lost
[/list]

[b]Dungeon Crawl[/b]
[list]
[*] Description updated to better describe the game
[*] Health bars now disappear for dead players
[/list]

[b]Minigolf[/b]
[list]
[*] The end of hole 6 is now angled so the ball ends up in the same spot
[*] New Scorecard that shows the scores of all players
[*] The scores of other players are greyed out so you can see your score easily
[*] The scorecard no longer shows the hole number, this was confusing and extra to most players in normal gamplay
[*] Finishing a course now highlights your total scores showing which players scored low enough
[*] Fixed a flickering artifact on the hole 'Around the Bend'
[*] The hole 'Around the Bend' had several cleanup changes to its mesh
[*] The ball no longer bounces of edges of the course mesh
[*] The Hardwood material that the sides of the courses are made of now looks better
[*] The hole 'Choices' had some improvements to the mesh
[*] The ending of 'Choices' was changed due to constant missing causing more than intended difficulty
[*] The mouse now works as intended if the keyboard/mouse player is playing
[/list]

[b]Monster Blast[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the spawn rate from 3 to 7 enemies per wave, to 3 to 5 + 'the number of players' enemies per wave
[*] Weakening and Burning passive upgrades now have their own icons
[*] A new passive 'Power Surge' has been added to extended mode. This gives electric damage a chance to hit again 1 second later. Each level increases the chance
[*] A new passive 'Astral Drag' has been added to extended mode. This makes arcane damage slow enemies by 10%. Each level increases the power of the slow effect
[*] A new passive 'Blunt Force' has been added to extended mode. This gives earth damage a chance to deal double damage. Each level increases the chance
[*] Players can no longer possibly upgrade health so much that it would be impossible for them to lose
[*] Monster damage now scales 'infinitely' in extended mode
[*] Fixed a bug where monsters could hit you from offscreen by being too large and not being able to path to you
[/list]

[b]Spaceship Shooter[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a (recently introduced) bug where the game would freeze in Versus mode
[/list]

[b]Target Practice[/b]
[list]
[*] Score text is now easier to see
[*] Targets now have a disintegrate effect when hit
[*] Target practice is now more difficult to account for changes in controls
[*] Removed the 'victory' count from the screen, this is only for Deathmatch
[/list]

[b]Menus[/b]
[list]
[*] Controls spaced better in the Game Description screen
[*] The Player Select screen now shows the controller gylph for Start instead of the word 'Start'
[*] Start and Select now have proper glyphs for keyboard/mouse controls
[*] Glyphs fade in/out quicker with multiple controllers
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple controllers of the same type would cause and no glyphs to appear 
[*] The Player Select screen now tells you how to drop out
[*] Fixed a bug where the selection arrows would not reset when selecting a player who dropped out previously
[*] The Back and Drop out options now only appear if a player is connected in the player select screen
[*] Players can no longer drop out after a game mode has been chosen
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] The minigame occurrence gap has been increased to 6 from 4. Playing the same game after 4 games still felt too soon. The gap is used in the Point Rush and Gauntlet modes
[*] Minigames now tell you why you lost in cases where it could be unclear
[*] 'Menu' text for the in game menu is now the correct larger size
[*] Fallback glyphs (Xbox) are now used in case the controller can't be resolved
[*] You can no longer 'win' the endless Gauntlet by losing
[*] New Gauntlet lose screen with appropriate music
[*] Fixed a bug in split screen games which made playing with 3 people have a weird 4th screen
[*] Split screen games have had their icons moved to avoid centered text
[*] Save files for Car Launch and Monster Blast now save for the amount of players playing. You will can now only see and load files with the correct number of players
[/list]

[b]Bird Panic[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players would 'fall off' the platform near the top when they shouldn't have
[/list]

[b]Car Launch[/b]
[list]
[*] Moved player icons and speedometer in split screen to be more visible
[*] The speedometer now has an outline to make it easier to read
[*] Fixed a bug where achievements weren't being checked
[*] Can no longer fall forever if you somehow manage to bounce the car backwards at an insane speed
[*] Buying an upgrade no longer causes the UI to reset its highlighting
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/65cbcc9ff0ff9a10d7f5425f56aa0d294bea0e7c.png[/img]

[b]Coin Collector[/b]
[list]
[*] Bad/Purple Coins now have a bad/purple sound effect
[*] Game instructions now state that bad coins are bad
[/list]

[b]Count'Em[/b]
[list]
[*] Count'Em now stops sending icons 7 seconds from the end up from 6 seconds
[*] The avatar icons now rotate to make the game more difficult
[/list]

[b]Deathmatch[/b]
[list]
[*] New leaders are now announced when the score changes
[*] The robots have named themselves hoping you will refuse to shoot them
[*] A 'victories' count has now been added in the bottom left corner
[*] The aiming controls have been rewritten and now should preform the same across different controllers
[*] The Crosshair is now much larger and clearer so you can see where you are shooting
[*] The AI now shoots slightly slower than players since they would consistently beat good players on normal difficulty
[*] Guns now point down to reload
[*] It now says 'RELOADING' on your screen when reloading to make it super clear
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/6ef955b084fe26f6a1e394fe9d7e8f9c1fe474ed.png[/img]

[b]Dungeon Crawl[/b]
[list]
[*] Archers will no longer stand in doorways while shooting
[*] You can no longer make your allies flash red by hitting them
[/list]

[b]Hotdog, No Hotdog[/b]
[list]
[*] Description now states the correct duration as 45 seconds
[/list]

[b]Minigolf[/b]
[list]
[*] Replace particle effect goal marker with a goal flag. This fades out as your ball gets closer to the hole
[*] All the balls now start in the same spot
[*] Other players' balls now fade when they get closer to your ball
[*] You can no longer see other players' power arrows
[*] Par was increased on several courses
[*] Number of difficulty categories for holes was reduced from 4 to 3. This increases the variety of courses playable on each game difficulty
[*] Golf balls are now coloured to your player colour with a white stripe in the middle
[*] Shooting controls have been redone. Instead of holding 'B' to aim and letting go to hit the ball, you are now always aiming and press 'B' to hit the ball. This is less confusing and we didn't find players were accidentally hitting the ball
[*] Fixed a bug where physics materials were wiped from all courses
[*] Rebalanced bounciness on the ball to make it more fun
[*] Reduced shot power from 24 to 18 to fit the fixed physics
[*] Fixed a bug where players using the keyboard couldn't hit the ball
[*] The ready bar is now your own
[*] When switching from 'In Play' to 'Ready' the bottom bar now changes colour to make it more obvious
[*] You can now press 'Y' to view your scorecard at any time
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/f95f874fb7d35bba412f37a213ad2fb5a01f21e8.png[/img]

[b]Monster Blast[/b]
[list]
[*] New Passive - Weakening:  Ice damage weakens enemies, increasing the damage dealt to them per level
[*] New Passive - Burning: Fire damage burns enemies dealing damage over time. The duration of the burn increases per level
[*] Losing a game in extended now properly lets you reduce progression or try again
[*] Can no longer use spells while in the upgrade screen
[*] Reduced the amount of particles in the Arcane Blast spell
[*] Fixed the icon for the Team Health upgrade
[*] Added music for the upgrade screen
[*] Added level up sound effect
[*] Completely redid upgrade screen
[*] Can now choose from 4 upgrades instead of 2
[*] Upgrade choices now better reflect the team's build
[*] Spell icons no longer become darker
[*] Spell icons no longer align to buttons
[*] The players' cursors are now hid when the game ends
[*] Screen now flashes red when you take damage; it could hard to tell before in all the chaos
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/f6b77b136fd696d44dee5aa69a902f601ac8296f.png[/img]

[b]Spaceship Shooter[/b]
[list]
[*] Altered the noise shooting makes to alleviate ear pain
[*] Fixed a bug where your ship could get tangled with an allies ship and was too funny
[/list]

[b]Rotate 8[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed navigation issues with going back and forth between the categories panel and the pictures panel
[*] You can now exit the extended rotate 8 menu back to the game mode menu
[*] Beginner mode no longer permalocks circles in their wrong positions
[*] The players' cursors are now hid when the game ends
[*] Added a way to back out of the difficulty selection
[*] Fixed a bug where unpausing Rotate 8 would sometimes still leave the players paused
[*] Re-extremed Extreme difficulty by disabling locking as intended
[/list]

[b]Target Practice[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with controller sensitivity
[/list]

[b]We You[/b]
[list]
[*] After every round it now tells you how many rounds are left in large text
[/list]

[b]Wolf Chase[/b]
[list]
[*] Apples now have an apple sound effect
[*] Berries now have a negative sound
[/list]

[b]Menus[/b]
[list]
[*] You now hold B for 4 seconds to leave the player select screen, instead of pressing X + Y + Start. Added a visual effect while holding to make it clear someone is trying to back out of the screen. It was difficult to hit all 3 buttons simultaneously, without hitting start first, and on controllers players weren't familiar with
[*] Added an Options button to the game mode menu for easier access
[*] The Player status screen now shows the buttons for picking a character, or choosing a new one
[*] Characters now correctly stop animating when not chosen
[*] Rules in the Change Rules menu are now saved between play sessions
[*] Fixed a bug where winning survival or losing gauntlet would get stuck in that state until you played a different game mode
[*] The navigation in the options menu now works as expected
[*] The Coop or Vs screen is now cleaner and clearer
[*] Point Rush in coop now shows a single team score instead of individual scores (that were all the same)
[*] Highlighted menu options now have a border making them much clearer to see
[*] Removed the 's' from '1 games left' in Survivor mode
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36890882/2c39b7a11fee7e16a4c27929289bc6d763ecb131.png[/img]
